Fixture: the decisions and comments of workflow/local-ci-…, for the Timeline tab's AC3 test.

## Decisions

- **D-1** · 2026-10-22 · lead chat: Integrated changes are tested by a local CI on the local main after every merge, and failures are reported into the system (Status, markers, lead). Engine feature, opt-in per project via ci: in workflow.yaml, "it feels like we should have local ci to test integrated changes and let the systme know about issues"
- **D-7** · 2026-10-22 · agent chat: One issue, built in phased commits in the lead's build order (run/status/reset, watcher + detached runs, reporting, enable here). Enabling CI in RogueTech stays with the RogueTech lead, "One issue, phased commits"
- **D-8** · 2026-10-22 · agent chat: Lead's open questions accepted: CI runs under nice; ux-test is a slow tier run only via ci run --tier slow; each run is a detached issue-cli ci run in tmux window ci-<project> with a per-project lock file, "Accept all three"
- **D-9** · 2026-10-22 · agent chat: ci.on_red defaults to mark (ci-red markers, ci: comments, lead nudge); file_issue stays available as an opt-in, "mark"
- **D-10** · 2026-10-22 · agent chat: Release gate deferred to ui/status-page-shows-what-waits-to-be-released; here ci status exposes the head-of-main state and the lead prompt refuses a release push while red, "Defer to that issue"
